title: minecraft-ai-agents: infrastructure, skill library, run data and analysis for four coding agents in survival Minecraft
description: Mineflayer bridge with a sandbox, a tested skill library (lib.obtain), agent watchdog, overhead/cutaway viewer, raw logs of a twelve-day run of four Gemini 3.8 Flash agents, and the scripts that rebuild every table and figure of the accompanying preprint.
